My stay at Aman Homestay in Kaza was absolutely wonderful and truly felt like a home away from home. The rooms were clean, cozy, and warm — perfect after long days of exploring Spiti in the cold weather.

The food was simple, homely, and delicious, and the overall vibe of the homestay was very peaceful and comforting. What made the stay even more special was the hospitality.

A heartfelt thanks to Tashi bhaiya, who helped us a lot throughout our stay. He was extremely kind, welcoming, and always ready to assist with anything we needed — whether it was guidance, local tips, or making sure we were comfortable. His warmth and care made the experience even more memorable.

I would highly recommend Aman Homestay to anyone visiting Kaza who wants a comfortable stay with genuine Spitian hospitality. Would love to stay here again whenever I’m back in Spiti 🌄✨
